content: Health numeracy is a critical component of diabetes care, requiring patients to possess the ability to interpret numerical data accurately. This includes understanding information such as food labels and blood glucose levels. Patients with low numeracy skills may struggle to make informed treatment decisions and may face challenges in performing essential self-management tasks related to their condition. Healthcare professionals are advised to actively screen for limitations in both health literacy and numeracy among their patients. When such limitations are identified, it is recommended that additional education and support be provided to ensure patients can effectively manage their diabetes and make appropriate health-related decisions.
